units.source_text: 薰中纳言每次看到二女公子的模样，总要想起：

en.t: Whenever Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, saw the Second Princess, he could not help remembering:

units.source_text: “我为什么违反大女公子的意愿而不娶此人呢？

en.t: Why did I go against the Elder Princess's wishes and fail to marry her?
I was truly far too irresolute.
His regret grew stronger with each passing day.
Before long, however, he changed his mind and thought:
What use is there in regretting it now?
It is all the result of my own actions.

units.source_text: 自从大女公子死后，他一直持斋，日夜勤修佛法。

en.t: Ever since the Elder Princess died, he had kept the fast and devoted himself day and night to Buddhist practice.

units.source_text: 母亲三公主至今还很年轻，性情天真烂漫。

en.t: His mother, the Third Princess, was still quite young, with an innocent and open-hearted nature.

units.source_text: 但她也注意到了儿子这般模样，深恐不吉，甚是担心，

en.t: But she too noticed this state of her son's, feared deeply that it was an ill omen, and became very anxious,
My life has not many days left.

units.source_text: 我总希望于在世期间看到你成家立业。

en.t: I have always hoped to see you establish a household and a settled life while I am still alive.

units.source_text: 我自己身为尼僧，未便阻止你出家离世。

en.t: Since I myself am a nun, it is not easy for me to stop you from renouncing the world.

units.source_text: 但你倘真个出家，我生在这世间毫无意趣，

en.t: But if you truly take holy orders, there will be no pleasure at all for me in remaining in this world,

units.source_text: 苦痛更多，罪孽也更深了。”

en.t: and my suffering will only increase, while my sins will grow still deeper.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言诚惶诚恐，自知对不起母亲，

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, was deeply humbled and knew that he had been unfilial to his mother,

units.source_text: 便摒除一切哀思，在母亲面前装作无忧无虑的模样。

en.t: so he put aside all his sorrow and acted carefree in his mother's presence.
